question: Does the direct post-threshold wonder helper contain a concrete item-202 city mutation, and which field does it change?

scope.boundary: This packet follows only the normalized-index-two, mode-bit-zero branch and its immediate calls. It does not classify 0x82D00C78, all entry conditions or callers, the complete city growth rules, persistent effects, display, AI, or runtime execution.

dependencies.use: Binds item 202 to the stored Hanging Gardens identity and description.
Provides the city-update caller, mode one, and helper body range.
Separates city player byte +0x00 from population byte +0x03 and establishes the latter's threshold consumer.

staticBranch.callsite: The accepted sufficient-production city path calls 0x82D16BA0 at 0x82D16340 with normalized index two, city index in r4, mode r5 = 1, and r6 = 0 when item 202 takes that path.
staticBranch.gate: After the helper's signed range check, mode bit zero enters the branch group. Comparison at 0x82D16CAC selects normalized index two; other indices branch to 0x82D16D0C.
staticBranch.source: The branch reads signed byte city[cityIndex].+0x03 from 0x8315FE28 + cityIndex*0xBC + 3 at 0x82D16CB8.
staticBranch.transform: It computes 3*x+1, divides by two with signed truncation toward zero, clamps the result to 0 through 31, and stores its low byte back to the same city +0x03 cell at 0x82D16CEC.
staticBranch.followup: It then calls 0x82D00C78 with the same city index at 0x82D16CF8 and re-enters city update 0x82D13978 with r3 = city index and r4 = -1 at 0x82D16D04, before leaving this local branch.
staticBranch.qualification: This is a concrete static population mutation path. The stored description says double growth in this city, but the exact one-time arithmetic is not itself proof of a persistent doubled growth rate or of runtime execution.

runtimeObservation.result: The earlier fresh-game probe observed inner eligibility calls but did not observe completion of item 202 or this post-threshold branch.

currentEvidence.method: One narrow generated-code window localized the item-two branch in the exact post-threshold helper. Foreground read-only canonical-project raw-word queries checked its comparison, signed arithmetic, clamp, +0x03 store, two calls, the growth-threshold helper's distinct +0x00 player load, and the city update's +0x03 increment.

entries.result: Index comparison, signed city +0x03 load, bounded transform, same-cell store, and two follow-up calls.
City +0x03 contributes to growth baseline; city +0x00 supplies the UEA player argument.
The city update increments the byte based on city +0x03 when stored progress reaches a growth threshold.

currentEvidence.qualification: The configured helper decompiler truncates at its save thunk, so current-image raw words and narrow exact-function generated-code windows support this static path. No runtime probe observed the branch.

guards: Do not equate this bounded immediate population change with every effect described by the record text.
Do not infer that items 233 through 236 run this helper body from their stored records.
Do not claim the two follow-up calls have specific gameplay effects without their own bounded consumers.
Do not claim runtime activation or a complete population formula from this static branch.
conclusion: On the accepted direct city-production path, the post-threshold helper's normalized-index-two branch can transform city population byte +0x03 to clamp(trunc((3*x+1)/2),0,31) and then call two city helpers. This is a concrete static item-202 population mutation, distinct from its stored description; runtime execution and any persistent growth-rate effect remain unobserved.
